title: Fix TypeScript entry point errors across all packages
body:
## Summary

Fixed TypeScript entry point errors by adding missing project references and required compiler options across 32 packages in the monorepo.

## Changes Made

### 1. Fixed @object-ui/react configuration
- Added missing `lib: ["ES2020", "DOM"]` to tsconfig.json
- Added missing `@object-ui/i18n` project reference

### 2. Fixed @object-ui/app-shell configuration  
- Added missing `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/layout` project references

### 3. Fixed @object-ui/fields and @object-ui/layout configuration
- Added `composite: true`, `declaration: true`, `noEmit: false`
- Added `lib: ["ES2020", "DOM"]`
- Fixed `rootDir` to be `"src"`
- Standardized `exclude` patterns

### 4. Added missing project references to 30 packages
Fixed all packages to include TypeScript project references matching their package.json dependencies:
- Core packages: auth, cli, collaboration, components, mobile, permissions, tenant, vscode-extension
- Plugin packages: All 22 plugin packages (aggrid, ai, calendar, charts, chatbot, dashboard, designer, detail, editor, form, gantt, grid, kanban, list, map, markdown, report, timeline, view, workflow)

## Technical Details

TypeScript's project references feature requires:
1. Each package must list its workspace dependencies in the `references` array
2. Referenced packages must have `composite: true` and `declaration: true`
3. React packages need `lib: ["ES2020", "DOM"]` for proper DOM type support

Without these configurations, TypeScript cannot resolve cross-package imports, causing "Cannot find module" errors during builds.

## Testing

- ✅ Verified @object-ui/react builds successfully
- ✅ Verified @object-ui/app-shell builds successfully  
- ✅ All packages now have matching references for their dependencies

## Impact

This fixes the entry point errors and ensures:
- Proper TypeScript incremental compilation across the monorepo
- Correct build ordering based on project dependencies
- Better IDE support for cross-package navigation
